THE BUSINESS GAP

Why does critical buyer context disappear after the test drive?

A vehicle purchase combines product, pricing, finance, trade-in and household input. Recording only the preferred model and follow-up status cannot preserve the buyer’s full decision process.

01

Needs are buried in long conversations

Features, space, range, handling, delivery and driving scenarios overlap, making complete manual notes difficult.

02

“Still considering” remains unexplained

Price, competitors, family input, trade-in valuation or finance may be the real barrier, while the system keeps only a vague status.

03

Showroom expertise is hard to replicate

The discovery, explanation and objection handling of strong advisors remain difficult to observe and teach.

FROM CONVERSATION TO ACTION

Four steps for automotive customer intelligence

Start with one showroom or team, a compliant communication source and measurable follow-up tasks, then expand only after real evaluation.

01

Capture approved sales conversations

With clear notice and permissions, connect selected showroom, test-drive review or follow-up call scenarios.

02

Build the vehicle buyer profile

Identify model, features, budget, finance, trade-in, use case, decision roles, competitors, concerns and timing.

03

Support advisor follow-up

Create summaries, actions, missing information and the focus for the next contact to reduce repetition and handoff loss.

04

Aggregate showroom and product insight

Observe recurring interests, loss reasons, competitor feedback and coaching themes with traceable context.

START WITH THE RIGHT TEAM

Which automotive teams should validate first?

  • Test drives and showroom conversations strongly influence decisions
  • Model, feature, finance and trade-in information is complex
  • Customers move between people or channels
  • CRM exists but notes still depend on manual entry
  • The team can evaluate accuracy and adoption with representative interactions
FAQ

Automotive sales AI FAQ

Is TellWin an automotive CRM?＋

No. TellWin focuses on conversation understanding and customer intelligence, returning reviewed structured outcomes to an existing CRM or retail system.

Can it recognize models and automotive terms?＋

Evaluation and configuration can cover brand, model, feature and workflow vocabulary, but accuracy must be validated with representative real samples.

Will it contact customers automatically?＋

The default is to produce summaries, actions and suggestions for advisor review. Automation depends on channels, business rules and compliance.

Where should a pilot begin?＋

Choose one showroom, one conversation scenario and clear tasks, then evaluate recognition quality, adoption and management value in real work.

This page describes the target automotive workflow and implementation approach. It does not claim standardized integration with every brand, retail system or communication channel; final scope depends on pilot evaluation.
